title: 送风头罩，一步步穿对（国内版）
author_source: project/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/47_POWERED AIR PURIFYING RESPIRATORS（国内版）/src.py

points.K12: 脱下：风机转着摘，再断电
points.S1: 用前三查：滤器、管路、风量
points.S3: 去污时，滤器风机别进水
points.S4: 戴头罩听不清，约定手势

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室更衣间，手捧一个白色送风头盔，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a laboratory changing room holding a white powered air hood helmet and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天学穿送风式呼吸头罩。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着头盔、电池、腰带三样东西
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a helmet, a battery pack and a belt laid on a bench.
shots.narration: 顺序错一步，都可能出危险。

shots.scene: 小研拿着空白通知，第一次要进高等级实验室
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a blank notice, preparing to enter a high containment laboratory for the first time.
shots.narration: 小研第一次要用送风头罩。

shots.scene: 小研拿起头盔左看右看，一脸疑惑
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns the helmet around with a puzzled look.
shots.narration: 这么多部件，先装哪个？

shots.scene: 老李推着设备车走进更衣间
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wheels an equipment cart into the changing room.
shots.narration: 老李来带她一步步穿。

shots.scene: 老李手指头盔顶部的过滤器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer points to the filter mounted on top of the helmet.
shots.narration: 头盔里装着过滤器，能挡住病原。

shots.scene: 头盔、头罩、电池、腰带四个部件摆开
shots.prompt_en: Four parts laid out on a bench: a helmet, a soft shroud, a battery pack and a belt. No people.
shots.narration: 头盔、头罩、电池、腰带，一整套。

shots.scene: 老李把白色披肩头罩从头盔上取下又装回
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer detaches the white shroud from the helmet and attaches it again.
shots.narration: 外面这层披肩头罩，可以更换。

shots.scene: 示意图：空气从头盔侧面吸入，经过滤器，向下吹过面部
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of air drawn in from the side of the helmet, passing a filter and flowing downward over the face. No people.
shots.narration: 空气从侧面吸进，过滤后吹向脸部。

shots.scene: 头罩内气流箭头向下、向外
shots.prompt_en: Arrows inside the hood flowing down and out under the shroud. No people.
shots.narration: 向下的气流，把脏空气挡在外面。

shots.scene: 电池组和连接线图标
shots.prompt_en: A battery pack icon with a connecting cable. No people.
shots.narration: 风机靠电池带动。

shots.scene: 小研把腰带系在腰上，老李帮她调松紧
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fastens a belt around her waist while the facility engineer helps adjust it.
shots.narration: 第一步，先系好腰带。

shots.scene: 穿上防护服后手够不到腰带的示意，问号
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a person in a protective suit unable to reach the belt underneath, with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 穿上防护服，就够不着了。

shots.scene: 电池放在充电座上，指示灯满格
shots.prompt_en: A battery pack on a charging dock showing a full charge indicator. No people.
shots.narration: 每次实验前，电池要充满。

shots.scene: 小研把电池卡进腰带上，咔哒一声
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student clips the battery pack firmly onto the belt.
shots.narration: 把电池牢牢装在腰带上。

shots.scene: 头罩上一滩液体溢洒的图标
shots.prompt_en: A shroud with a liquid spill mark on it. No people.
shots.narration: 头罩去污后可以再用。

shots.scene: 沾了溢洒的头罩放进生物危害废物袋，新头罩换上
shots.prompt_en: A spill-stained shroud goes into a biohazard waste bag and a fresh shroud is fitted. No people.
shots.narration: 可一旦沾上溢洒，就换新的。

shots.scene: 老李演示转动头盔内的头箍旋钮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer turns the headband adjustment knob inside the helmet.
shots.narration: 调节头箍，让它稳稳贴住额头。

shots.scene: 小研把电源线一端插到电池上，另一端插到头盔
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student plugs the cable into the battery and the helmet.
shots.narration: 戴上之前，先插好电源线。

shots.scene: 不通电就戴上头罩的图标被打叉，旁边红色警示
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person wearing an unpowered hood, crossed out with a red X and a red warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 不送风戴着头罩，会喘不上气！

shots.scene: 电池上三个指示灯全部亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three indicator lights all turn on on the battery pack. No people.
shots.narration: 开机，看指示灯是不是全亮。

shots.scene: 电池图标和时钟，旁边一本空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: A battery icon with a clock beside a blank instruction manual. No people.
shots.narration: 能用多久看说明书，不够就别进去。

shots.scene: 小研双手戴上头盔，披肩垂下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts the helmet on with both hands and the shroud drapes down.
shots.narration: 风机转着，戴上头盔。

shots.scene: 老李帮她系紧颈部的带子
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer helps tighten the straps around her neck.
shots.narration: 系紧带子，披肩盖住肩膀。

shots.scene: 小研慢慢转一圈，老李查看前后
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns around slowly while the facility engineer checks front and back.
shots.narration: 转一圈，前后都检查到位。

shots.section_title: 用前三查：滤器、管路、风量
shots.scene: 老李拿起过滤器看型号标签和有效期
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer examines the filter's blank label for type and expiry.
shots.narration: 用前先查：滤器型号对不对，过没过期。
overlay: 用前三查：滤器、管路、风量

shots.section_title: 用前三查：滤器、管路、风量
shots.scene: 老李检查连接线和头罩有没有破口
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects the cable and shroud for cracks or tears.
shots.narration: 再查连接线和头罩有没有破损。

shots.section_title: 用前三查：滤器、管路、风量
shots.scene: 小研把头盔接上风量检测器，指示浮球升起
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student attaches the helmet to an airflow test tube and the indicator float rises.
shots.narration: 最后测一测送风量够不够。

shots.section_title: 用前三查：滤器、管路、风量
shots.scene: 风量不够的头盔贴上停用牌
shots.prompt_en: A helmet with weak airflow gets a do-not-use tag. No people.
shots.narration: 有一项不合格，就停用报修。

shots.scene: 小研穿好连体防护服、双层手套，再戴送风头罩
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a full protective coverall, double gloves and the powered air hood.
shots.narration: 送风头罩只护呼吸和头面部。

shots.scene: 短袖便装只戴头罩的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person in a short-sleeved shirt wearing only the hood, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 防护服、手套，一样不能少。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白评估表核对装备
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the equipment against a blank assessment form.
shots.narration: 穿什么，按风险评估和规程来。

shots.section_title: 戴头罩听不清，约定手势
shots.scene: 小研在实验室里说话，旁边嗡嗡的风机声波图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student talks inside the lab while a buzzing fan sound wave icon appears.
shots.narration: 戴上头罩，风声大，说话听不清。
overlay: 戴头罩听不清，约定手势

shots.section_title: 戴头罩听不清，约定手势
shots.scene: 小研和同伴互相比手势：竖拇指、交叉手臂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and a partner exchange hand signals: thumbs up and crossed arms.
shots.narration: 进去前约好手势：好、停、出去。

shots.section_title: 戴头罩听不清，约定手势
shots.scene: 墙上的对讲机和呼叫按钮
shots.prompt_en: An intercom and a call button on the laboratory wall. No people.
shots.narration: 也要知道对讲和呼叫在哪。

shots.section_title: 脱下：风机转着摘，再断电
shots.scene: 小研回到指定脱卸区，风机仍在转
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student returns to the designated doffing area with the fan still running.
shots.narration: 脱的时候，风机先别关。
overlay: 脱下：风机转着摘，再断电

shots.section_title: 脱下：风机转着摘，再断电
shots.scene: 小研双手托住头盔后部，向上向前摘下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts the helmet off from the back with both hands.
shots.narration: 按规程摘下头盔。

shots.section_title: 脱下：风机转着摘，再断电
shots.scene: 摘下后，才拔下电源线
shots.prompt_en: After the helmet is off, the power cable is unplugged. No people.
shots.narration: 摘下来以后，再断开电池。

shots.scene: 头盔放在托盘上，用消毒湿巾擦拭表面
shots.prompt_en: A helmet on a tray being wiped with disinfectant wipes by a gloved hand.
shots.narration: 每次用完，表面去污。

shots.scene: 消毒剂瓶和空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: A disinfectant bottle next to a blank instruction sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 用推荐的消毒剂，按说明擦。

shots.scene: 旧头罩放进废物袋，换上新头罩
shots.prompt_en: An old shroud goes into a waste bag and a new shroud is fitted. No people.
shots.narration: 需要时，换上新头罩。

shots.section_title: 去污时，滤器风机别进水
shots.scene: 过滤器和风机图标上方一个水滴被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A filter and blower icon with a water drop above them, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 擦的时候，滤器和风机别进水。
overlay: 去污时，滤器风机别进水

shots.section_title: 去污时，滤器风机别进水
shots.scene: 把头盔泡进水盆的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a helmet being soaked in a basin, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能泡，不能冲。

shots.section_title: 去污时，滤器风机别进水
shots.scene: 电池接口贴着防水小帽
shots.prompt_en: A protective cap covering the battery connector. No people.
shots.narration: 接口盖好，电池单独擦。

shots.scene: 电池放回充电座，日历上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The battery pack is placed back on the charging dock with a calendar tick. No people.
shots.narration: 用完马上充电，下次才放心。

shots.scene: 小研在空白使用记录本上签名
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student signs a blank equipment usage log.
shots.narration: 签好使用记录。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁一排步骤图标：腰带、电池、头箍、插电、灯亮、系带
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a row of step icons: belt, battery, headband, plug, lights and straps.
shots.narration: 腰带、电池、头箍、先插电，再戴上。

shots.scene: 放大镜、软管、风量浮球三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a magnifier, a hose and an airflow float. No people.
shots.narration: 用前查滤器、管路和风量。

shots.scene: 风机转着摘头盔、再断电的两格图
shots.prompt_en: Two panels: removing the helmet with the fan on, then unplugging the cable. No people.
shots.narration: 脱时风机先转着，摘下再断电。

shots.scene: 擦拭头盔、充电座、手势三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: wiping a helmet, a charging dock and a hand signal. No people.
shots.narration: 去污别进水，充电记录，手势约好。

shots.scene: 欣欣和穿戴整齐的小研、老李一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye together with the fully protected female graduate student and the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 一步步穿对，安全才有保障，再见！
